_note: Research is done inside the Nhà nghiên cứu by villagers who work there: the more and the smarter, the faster. Every tool, weapon and armour has ONE blueprint that is raised step by step (tech id = recipe id: axe1 is the wood axe, axe2 the stone one); a recipe can only be made once its blueprint step is researched and the Nhà chế tạo is high enough (recipeLevel). cost may include coin (shells in the stone age). time is seconds at speed 1 with one average researcher; the best researcher inside must reach minInt. needLevel is the Nhà nghiên cứu level. unlocks: recipes, levels (highest level per building kind), buildings (kinds that may be built), auto (fetch: villagers fetch tools from the stores; order: villagers order crafting and repair themselves). Set enabled to false to open everything.
